PROMPT_SELL: Put your vehicle up for sale
SELL_MENU_LIST_DESC: Set a price; other players buy it, you get paid when it sells.
SELL_MENU_DEALER_DESC: Paid at once, the vehicle is gone for good.
SELL_DESCRIPTION_HINT: Low mileage, new tyres, never crashed...
SELL_TERMS_TEXT: The lot keeps {0}% of the price. You get the rest when it sells, even while you are away. You can have {1} vehicles listed at once and take a listing back at any time.
NOTIFY_LISTED: Your vehicle is up for sale for ${0}. You get ${1} when it sells.
NOTIFY_BOUGHT: The vehicle is yours, it is waiting at the lot
NOTIFY_TAKEN_BACK: Your vehicle is back, it is waiting at the lot
NOTIFY_IMPOUND: The vehicle could not be brought out, pick it up at an impound lot
NOTIFY_PAID: Your listed vehicles sold: ${0} paid to your account
NOTIFY_SOLD_DEALER: You sold the vehicle to the dealer for ${0}
MAIL_LINE: Your vehicle {0} sold. ${1} was paid to your account.
ERR_GONE: That vehicle is not for sale any more
ERR_NOT_DRIVING: Drive the vehicle you want to sell onto the spot
ERR_OCCUPIED: Everyone else has to get out first
ERR_NOT_OWNED: Only vehicles from a garage can be sold here
ERR_PRICE: That price is not allowed here
ERR_LIMIT: You already have as many vehicles listed as you may
ERR_FAILED: That did not work, try again
ERR_OWN: You cannot buy your own vehicle, take it back instead
ERR_BUSY: Someone else is dealing for this vehicle right now
ERR_BLOCKED: Something is standing on the delivery spot
ERR_NO_DEALER: The dealer does not buy this vehicle
ERR_MONEY: You do not have enough money
ERR_DRIVING: You are already on a test drive
ERR_COOLDOWN: Wait a little before the next test drive
ERR_SPAWN: The test drive vehicle could not be brought out
UI_EMPTY: Nothing is for sale here yet
UI_YOU_GET: You get ${0} when it sells ({1}% stays with the lot)
UI_PICK_HINT: Choose one below to look it over, test drive or buy it.
UI_TIMER_HINT: Get out to end it early
ADMIN_ERR_PRICE_RANGE: The lowest price must not be above the highest price
ADMIN_TAB_LOTS_DESC: Where players sell their vehicles to each other.
ADMIN_DELETE_LOT_DESC: Vehicles listed at this lot stay stored with their sellers' listings; they show again when a lot with the same key exists.
ADMIN_C_LOT_DESC: The counter players browse from, where they drive in to sell and how far the parked cars show.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Stand where players open the list of vehicles for sale and use your position.
ADMIN_H_AREA: Metres around the counter. Parked cars show to players inside, and buyers must be inside to buy or test drive.
ADMIN_H_SELL: Where players drive in with the vehicle they want to sell.
ADMIN_C_SPOTS_DESC: Where listed vehicles stand on the lot, first listed first parked. More listings than spots are still for sale on the counter's list.
ADMIN_C_SHOWROOM_DESC: Where the vehicle a player looks at stands, where the camera looks from and where bought, taken back and test drive vehicles come out.
ADMIN_H_PREVIEW: Stand where the shown vehicle should be, facing its front direction.
ADMIN_H_CAMERA: Look at the preview spot with the game camera and use the camera position.
ADMIN_H_DELIVERY: A free place on the road, facing the way out. It may be the preview spot.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Prices, the lot's cut, payment and test drives.
ADMIN_C_SALES_DESC: What sellers may ask and how much the lot keeps.
ADMIN_H_COMMISSION: Part of the price that stays with the lot; the seller gets the rest.
ADMIN_H_COMMISSION_TO: A job's or gang's shared account receives the cut of every sale. None: the money leaves the economy.
ADMIN_H_COMMISSION_ACCOUNT: The job's or gang's shared account the cut is paid into.
ADMIN_H_MAX_LISTINGS: How many vehicles one character may have for sale at once, over every lot.
ADMIN_C_DEALER_DESC: At the sell spot a player may also sell an owned vehicle straight to the lot. The vehicle is deleted and the player paid at once.
ADMIN_H_DEALER_SHARE: Part of the vehicle shop's catalog price paid into the seller's account. 0 turns the dealer off; vehicles missing from the catalog are never bought.
ADMIN_C_PAYMENT_DESC: Where buyers pay from and where sellers are paid.
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNTS: Tried in this order until one has enough money.
ADMIN_H_PAYOUT_ACCOUNT: Paid when the vehicle sells, or at the seller's next login when offline.
ADMIN_C_TEST_DRIVE_DESC: A temporary copy of a listed vehicle the buyer may drive before paying.
ADMIN_H_TEST_DRIVE_COOLDOWN: Seconds one character waits before the next test drive (0 = none).
ADMIN_C_BLIP_DESC: How lots with the map blip switched on look on the map.
